classification: Prospective conditional predictive-skill study; not general empirical adequacy
sampleRationale: Ten predeclared 90-second observation blocks constitute a bounded finite-recording assessment. Retain the historical minimum ten-following/five-queue recruitment requirements without claiming a powered population sample. If unmet, the corresponding claim is inconclusive. Do not add blocks, drop errors or relax targets after seeing held-out data.

statisticalDesign.unit: At most one episode of each kind per 90-second block; aggregate followers within a queue. Never resample frames as independent observations.
plannedComparisons: following HTC minus constant velocity position RMSE
following HTC minus causal rigid spacing position RMSE
queue HTC minus causal rigid spacing headway MAE
statisticalDesign.decision: Primary sigma=0 only. For each comparison require the one-sided Bonferroni upper percentile-bootstrap bound at 1-0.05/3 to be below zero. Also require the relevant data gate, complete primary predictions/crossings and nonnegative primary bumper gaps.
statisticalDesign.interpretation: Within-recording block-bootstrap uncertainty is exploratory; adjacent traffic conditions may remain dependent. No population superiority or universal physical adequacy claim.

rules: Remove exact duplicates, reject conflicting subject/time rows, truncation, missing 100 ms samples and nonconsecutive frame IDs.
Every subject remains a northbound through passenger Car in one unchanged lane; every follower retains its recorded immediate leader throughout initialization and prediction.
Use front-center local_y and measured lengths, converted from feet. Reject nonfinite data, negative annotated speeds, reversed steps beyond tolerance or overlapping observed bumpers.
Initialize speed by least-squares position slope over the disjoint one-second prefix; head-leader velocity at each boundary uses only its previous one-second positions, floored at zero.

Queue prefix fitted speed must remain within the stop threshold for all three Cars. The fixed virtual discharge station is 5 m beyond the head leader's initial front. All observed subjects must cross within 20 seconds; missing predicted crossings fail coverage, never exclude the case.
Retain all raw responses, query URLs, SHA256, license and every rejection. No fitted time shifts, post-outcome filtering or traffic-coefficient calibration.

followingContext.interpretation: Leader-dominated midblock component scope. Does not infer signals or exclude indirect upstream/downstream traffic effects.

queueRelease.releaseDefinition: First annotated head-leader speed >0.2 m/s after a one-second stopped initialization prefix, with >=0.3 m observed head displacement during the next second. All three prefix fitted speeds remain <=0.2 m/s in absolute value.
queueRelease.endpoint: Ceil the last observed station crossing plus one second to the 0.1 s grid, with a minimum five seconds and maximum twenty. Require complete common coverage through that endpoint. Missing predicted crossings fail coverage. Do not extend a failed prediction horizon.
queueRelease.station: 5 m beyond the observed head front at the last initialization sample; physical station and identities shared by all comparisons.
queueRelease.interpretation: Conditional queue-release response to observed head motion, not reconstruction of the green phase or saturated signal capacity.

stochasticRole: Predeclared secondary sensitivity only; average separately scored seed metrics within episode. Do not choose a best seed or use this variant for the primary acceptance gate.
baselineInformation: Constant velocity uses the initial follower prefix only. Causal rigid spacing uses head position and causal velocity at the start of the forecast interval, with one-step constant-speed head extrapolation; no current/future head frame or future follower observation enters dynamics.
desiredSpeedInterpretation: Fixed transferred 56.32704 km/h model cap from the existing benchmark, not a verified Peachtree posted speed limit and not calibrated on Peachtree outcomes.
calibration: None. All acceleration, braking, gap, reaction and speed-cap parameters are fixed before reserved access. Development data informed tooling and recruitment design only.
claimBoundary: Conditional longitudinal following and observed head-release response for stable northbound through passenger-car chains in this held-out recording. Future lane/leader stability and complete observed discharge define eligibility, so results do not estimate all-traffic occurrence. No actor-runtime, autonomous signal, lane-change, corridor, safety or general empirical-adequacy validation.
missingPolicy: Retain every selected episode and all prediction samples. Missing predicted queue crossings invalidate the affected headline and comparison; they never exclude an episode. Failed scientific or recruitment gates are completed experiments, not execution failures.
